description: Rubric bank for the Workplace Communication dojo (Phase 6). Rubrics are LENSES, not verdicts: every dimension anchors to utterance-level evidence; scores are directional practice signals. Auto-coded scores (Han 2026 ~52.6% accuracy) are inputs requiring evidence anchoring. Rubric selection matches practice_target (professional clarity for requests/updates; feedback effectiveness for feedback; negotiation align for priority conflicts and disagreement).

rubrics.target: workplace requests, updates, and written communication practice

dimensions.metric: share of turns where purpose precedes detail
dimensions.note: workplace norm: purpose-first framing; a buried purpose is a buried ask
the classic failure is the implicit ask; explicit ask names owner + deadline

dimensions.metric: context enough for the counterpart to act, without padding
dimensions.note: under-context forces follow-up loops; over-context buries the ask
commitments recorded in commit-close; actionability is the carry-forward test
written channel (email-equivalent) must not rely on tone/body cues (transfer scenarios)

dimensions.metric: SBI structure: situation-behavior-impact; observable behavior, not labels
dimensions.note: 'lazy' is a label; 'three late handoffs this month' is behavior

dimensions.metric: strengths and gaps both named; no personal attack
invites the recipient's response and listens to it
dimensions.note: feedback is a dialogue, not a verdict delivery
co-created next steps survive; dictated ones do not

dimensions.metric: receive-mode: non-defensive response, clarification questions, appreciation

rubrics.target: priority alignment, delegation, and professional disagreement practice

dimensions.metric: names underlying interests (both sides), not just positions
dimensions.note: interest-based: position 'no' hides an interest that may be met another way

dimensions.metric: no escalation at stress levels; disagreement stays respectful
names what each side gives and gets
dimensions.note: alignment is a trade, and the trade must be visible

dimensions.metric: commitment specific, owned by the user, followable

rubric_use_rules: rubrics are lenses: scores anchor to quotes, never standalone
no rubric score becomes a verdict about the user as a person
rubric selection matches practice_target; provisional rubrics are marked provisional
debrief template (debrief_template.md) consumes rubric output with evidence sections
power-gradient note: when the persona outranks the user, over-deference markers are flagged in the feedback_effectiveness / negotiation rubrics, never scored as proficiency
